name: Tirth's Haunt
summary: Tirth's Haunt is a lonely, peculiar campsite located in the arid flatlands of Thousand Needles, situated just south of the Southsea Holdfast. It serves as the refuge of the eccentric hermit Magus Tirth and his unusual companion, a polymorphed chicken named "Plucky" Johnson. Adventurers, particularly wandering mages, occasionally cross the scorched salt flats to consult the eccentric spellcaster.

sections.title: A Magus in the Salt Flats
sections.body: Perched in the harsh, sun-baked landscape of Thousand Needles, Tirth's Haunt is little more than a spartan camp just south of the Southsea Holdfast. The camp is dominated by the unpredictable Magus Tirth, a mage of considerable talent who has isolated himself far from the arcane towers of civilization. Instead of scholarly peers, Tirth shares his solitary haunt with an unfortunate polymorphed human named "Plucky" Johnson, whom the magus relentlessly badgers. Despite his erratic temperament and bizarre isolation, Tirth remains an arcane practitioner of genuine skill, drawing travelers seeking odd spells, strange ingredients, or ancient warlock and mage lore across the desert dust.

faq.answer: Tirth's Haunt is situated in the eastern reaches of Thousand Needles, right on the fringes of the Shimmering Flats and just south of the pirate stronghold known as Southsea Holdfast.

The camp is inhabited by the eccentric human mage Magus Tirth and a chicken named "Plucky" Johnson. Tirth keeps to himself out in the desert, though his sanity is somewhat dubious and he spends much of his time tormenting his feathered companion.

faq.q: What is the deal with the chicken named Plucky?
faq.answer: "Plucky" Johnson is not a natural bird, but rather a human who ran afoul of arcane magic and was permanently polymorphed into a chicken. Magus Tirth keeps Plucky around his campsite, frequently zapping and berating him.

faq.q: Why would adventurers visit this campsite?
faq.answer: Mages and spellcasters often seek out Tirth as part of their arcane training and trials. Despite his bizarre demeanor, Tirth possesses specialized knowledge of wandmaking, rare reagents, and ritual magics.

angles.text: Mages wandering Thousand Needles may find business with Tirth, an eccentric peer living in isolation whose arcane mastery remains formidable despite his peculiarities.
